summary: Canonical production-attached offline integration proof for the complete landed M3 recording system.

entries.contract: One offline Swift system executes the actual rev-2 operation registry, store, recovery, control, screen geometry/follow adapter, multitrack coordinator, artifact custody, shared microphone adapter/session, and public projectors with injected non-native dependencies. It covers all fixed/followed track selections, admission-before-authority, common epoch, backpressure, duration, control boundaries and races, geometry failure/recovery families, custody CAS/recovery, and deterministic store-fault families.
entries.worth: This catches cross-owner defects that focused schema, static, compile, or separately isolated harnesses cannot prove, while remaining content-free and permissionless.
entries.guard: No repo binary, live service, native capture API authority, device, filesystem media, TCC, pixels, audio, or UI executes; emitted public admissions, follow results, snapshots, events, custody results, and response envelopes validate against the exact checked-in schemas.
